interior_transformation.focus: The documented before state, design decision and completed result.
interior_transformation.structure: Specific problem or goal, design solution, visible outcome, consultation CTA.
rules: Use the same real space for before and after.
Do not digitally enlarge rooms or change structural features.
Mention only decisions documented by the designer.
Do not invent budget, timeline, material or client brief.
Avoid insulting the original space.

project_reveal.focus: The project's design idea, spatial flow, key details and lived experience.
required_details: Photography or video credit when required
rules: Use the project's approved name.
Do not reveal the client's identity or address without permission.
Do not claim completion dates or area without documentation.
Credit collaborators when supplied.

room_showcase.focus: One room, its purpose and two or three real design decisions.
rules: Name materials and finishes only when confirmed.
Describe hidden storage only when shown or documented.
Do not imply every decor item was designed or supplied by the studio.
Connect visual design to actual function.

site_progress.focus: A real project stage and what is being resolved.
rules: State the actual stage, such as demolition, civil work, electrical, carpentry, finish or styling.
Do not call a site on schedule without the current timeline.
Protect client address and building details.
Use required safety practices in filmed site content.

architect_explainer.focus: One space-planning, lighting, storage, material or execution lesson.
architect_explainer.structure: Common problem, professional reasoning, practical takeaway, consultation CTA.
rules: Use studio-approved technical guidance.
Avoid universal rules when the answer depends on site conditions.
Do not estimate costs without dimensions, materials and scope.
Make the explanation understandable to homeowners.

material_or_detail.focus: The confirmed material, finish, junction, hardware or custom element and why it was chosen.
rules: Use exact product and brand names only when supplied.
Do not promise scratch resistance, waterproofing, fire resistance or durability without specifications.
Distinguish visual preference from performance data.

client_review.status: Use only when an actual client review and publication permission are supplied.
rules: Keep the review faithful.
Do not invent project budget, handover date or testimonial details.
Do not reveal the home address.

offer_or_consultation.rule: Do not advertise free design, free consultation or fixed packages without written confirmation.

project_description_framework.rule: Use only fields documented for the exact project. Omit unconfirmed fields rather than filling them with generic assumptions.

interior_accuracy_rules.space_rule: Do not infer room dimensions, ceiling height or apartment area from images.
interior_accuracy_rules.material_rule: Do not identify marble, veneer, laminate, wood species, paint, fabric or hardware by appearance alone.
interior_accuracy_rules.structure_rule: Do not claim a wall was removed, plumbing moved or structure changed unless documented.
interior_accuracy_rules.budget_rule: Do not quote project budget, per-square-foot rate or savings without an approved estimate.
interior_accuracy_rules.timeline_rule: Do not promise a handover date or standard duration without scope and site conditions.
interior_accuracy_rules.render_rule: Clearly distinguish 3D render, work-in-progress image and completed-site photograph.
interior_accuracy_rules.photo_rule: Do not make a completed space appear larger or materially different through AI editing.
interior_accuracy_rules.credit_rule: Preserve photographer, architect, stylist, contractor and vendor credits supplied for the project.

caption_format.body_word_target: 35 to 80 words, excluding footer, hashtags and keyword bracket.
caption_format.short_reveal_word_target: 15 to 45 words when the visual explains the transformation.
caption_format.educational_word_target: 45 to 100 words when design reasoning needs context.
sequence: One challenge and solution or two project details
One consultation, save or share CTA
Exactly one square bracket containing comma-separated SEO phrases
caption_format.line_breaks: Use short paragraphs and a blank line before the footer and hashtag block.
caption_format.body_emojis: Usually zero to two. Keep the tone refined.
caption_format.hashtag_selection: Normally one brand tag, one project or design tag and one Mumbai or room-specific tag.
caption_format.seo_format: [keyword one, keyword two, keyword three, keyword four, keyword five]
caption_format.output_rule: Return only ready-to-copy public text unless another format is requested.

other_output_modes.story: One or two design-led lines with a consultation, poll or save action. Omit full footer, hashtags and SEO bracket unless requested.
other_output_modes.comment: One short professional design observation. Do not impersonate a client.
other_output_modes.review_reply: Thank the client and avoid revealing budget, location or project issues.
